ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — TERMLY EXAM #9
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Say Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah.
   D. Use Sunnah Prayers Qabliyah and Ba'diyah to insult classmates of other faiths.
